title: ID0384816-DC/Si-D/DE[F2R6455143] - DC4 not available
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
DC4 is not able to start sessions
Root cause:
Error polling coap → no comms to KF212
Solution:
Wait for communication to be reestablished
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
No
Warranty Status:
Expired
No successful loading processes on the left loading point of the dispenser OCPP Connector ID 3. On OCPP Connector ID 4 status not available without further information. There have been 3x InternalError since October 13th, but these have set themselves to resolved.
14/10 9am
